parsed.explanation: The write-up proves orbit invariance (4) but never states or proves that g(x) cannot be negative. Thus “at most one positive value” does not justify V⊆{0,c}. A single added argument repairs it: if g(x)=a<0, then repeated use of (4) gives f^n(x)=x+na and g(x+na)=a while the orbit is defined; choosing n large makes x+na≤0, contradicting that every iterate lies in R_{>0}.
